facts.text: Daltoni was a Serbian and former Yugoslav rock band whose name translates to "The Daltons."
facts.source_quote: Daltoni (Serbian Cyrillic: Далтони; translation: "The Daltons") was a Serbian and former Yugoslav rock band from Niš

facts.text: The Dalton Gang was a group of outlaws in the American Old West during 1890–1892.
facts.source_quote: The Dalton Gang was a group of outlaws in the American Old West during 1890–1892.

relations.text: The Yugoslav rock band Daltoni's name translates into English as "The Daltons," the same name shared (as "Dalton") by the 1890s American outlaw group, the Dalton Gang.
